# config commands persist and read settings through the real binary
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input config set network.ca_cert_file /tmp/test-ca.pem
stderr 'Set network.ca_cert_file = /tmp/test-ca.pem'

exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input config get network.ca_cert_file
stdout '/tmp/test-ca.pem'

exists $MUSHER_CONFIG_HOME/config.yaml
